description: STRATEGIC MEMO — EDIS + OPS HARDENING 2026-06-12: Two new tracks added to backlog. S23 = EDIS, the WordPress public face of FatBaby signal intelligence. Scaffold complete: edis-core plugin (WP HTTP API client + transient cache + admin settings), edis-signals plugin (shortcodes + widget for governance signals / entity / EPS), edis-ask-emily plugin (Ask Emily widget + WP REST proxy to Emily Prime). Starter theme with /ticker/{SYM} rewrite, sidebar, header/footer. S24 = Newssite ops hardening before traffic hits: nginx proxy cache (60s TTL, stale-while-revalidate), rate limiting (5 req/s/IP, burst 20), systemd service units for all Go processes, docker-compose.prod.yml for MySQL+MongoDB+nginx, deploy.sh, ops-runbook.md. CEO says: we will get hit hard once people figure out we have good data. Your task: read EDIS/NORTHSTAR.md and PRRJECT_FATBABY/docs/ops-runbook.md. Synthesize the full picture. Identify the next 3 highest-leverage items across S23+S24. Post a synthesis Apple. Update HEIMDAL if any items should become sprints. Think hard about sequencing: EDIS needs signalapi live (S20 done) and a host. Ops hardening needs a server. What is the critical path to first paying Emily+ subscriber?
